disclosures.storage: Mem0 OSS with a fresh local Qdrant collection and SQLite history database per benchmark question
disclosures.writePolicy: Run Mem0 inference for every allowed event separately with its fixture event ID in metadata; accepted-only by default and include tentative events only for an explicit tentative view
disclosures.retrievalPolicy: Mem0 search with question text, user filter, and fixture topK or 5; deduplicate returned event IDs in score order
disclosures.providerCostBoundary: OpenRouter LLM calls are provider-charged and reported from native response usage; embeddings and storage are local
notes: Mem0 performs its native LLM memory extraction and update decision before local vector retrieval.
Retrieval-only scoring: no separate answer reader is added and proof citations remain unsupported.
Mem0 telemetry is disabled. spaCy is intentionally not installed, so Mem0 uses its built-in non-spaCy fallback.
Dependency/model initialization is excluded from wallMs; memory ingestion, provider latency, local embedding, and search are included.
